title: CE-RISE Intelligent Circular Insights Workbench
description: An AI-assisted workbench for querying, validating, repairing and generating Digital Product Passport records. Answers cite supporting evidence or are declined when support is insufficient. Generated records are checked against the applied validation profile and include field-level support; repair separates evidence-backed changes from unverified suggestions. General-purpose and CE-RISE profiles provide access to product records, CE-RISE data models and the PEFDPP knowledge graph. Vendored CE-RISE data models are separately licensed CC-BY-NC-4.0 in schemas/ce-rise/.
